flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Research Associate II, NGS
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: About Alltrna Alltrna is the first clinical-stage biotech company advancing tRNA medicines to address shared disease-causing mutations across many indications. The company’s initial therapeutic programs are designed to restore full-length protein production in diseases caused by premature termination codons (PTCs), collectively referred to as Stop Codon Disease, which affect approximately 10% of people with a rare genetic disease. Alltrna’s lead program, AP003, is a chemically modified, engineered tRNA oligonucleotide encapsulated in a clinically validated, liver-directed lipid nanoparticle. AP003 is being developed for the arginine-to-TGA (Arg-TGA) PTC in patients with liver Stop Codon Disease, including phenylketonuria, organic acidemias, and urea cycle disorders. Founded in 2018 by Flagship Pioneering, Alltrna has built an integrated platform to design, optimize, and deliver engineered tRNA therapeutics. For more information, visit www.alltrna.com Research Associate II / Senior Research Associate, Next-Generation Sequencing Position Summary: Come join Alltrna and be an integral part of the Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) Core within our Computational and Molecular Biology team. We are seeking a highly motivated and organized Research Associate to support the RNA-based NGS methods and experiments that empower Alltrna’s platform. The role will own end-to-end execution of NGS experiments, spanning sample extraction through sequencing, quality control, and documentation. Alltrna’s NGS pipeline is central to company initiatives, and this role will collaborate closely with a cross-functional team of scientists in molecular biology, computational biology, and lab automation. The successful candidate should be able to work effectively in a team-oriented group and is accustomed to consistently delivering high-quality data on a timeline. This position reports to the NGS Core Lead. Key Responsibilities: Execute end-to-end NGS experiments, including RNA extraction from tissues and cells, tRNA-seq and small RNA-seq library preparation, sequencer operation, and quality control. Independently operate automation equipment, including KingFisher, Mantis, and Biomek liquid handlers. Evaluate run and sample QC metrics, proactively flag deviations and out-of-spec results, troubleshoot to root cause. Follow SOPs and contribute to maintaining and updating these as workflows evolve. Document all procedures, data, and observations in our electronic laboratory notebook system (Benchling) to maintain accuracy and traceability. Contribute to the design and execution of experiments to evaluate data-driven NGS workflow improvements, supporting gains in quality, throughput, and efficiency. Contribute to sample and reagent inventory management, ordering, batch certification, equipment readiness, and laboratory organization. Collaborate with sample intake, computational, and automation teams to ensure both sample and data quality. Qualifications and Skills BS/MS in biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, or a related discipline, with 2+ years (RA II) or 4+ years (Senior RA) of relevant experience. Hands-on experience with nucleic acids, including RNA/DNA extraction and quantification, PCR, qPCR, gel electrophoresis, and Illumina NGS library preparation. Working understanding of the molecular biology and QC metrics that underlie NGS workflows and Illumina sequencing. Ability to stay organized and complete a high volume of requests on time, while maintaining accuracy and quality. Demonstrated ability to think critically, troubleshoot, and problem-solve. Track record of identifying and contributing to data-driven workflow improvements. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the demonstrated ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team. The preferred candidate will ideally also possess the following skills: Experience with small RNAs or RNA library construction. jobgether-jobgether:lever:14e532df-b495-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager (Subscriptions) based in the United States. This is a high-impact growth role focused on driving profitable acquisition and long-term subscriber growth for a consumer subscription product. You will own high-priority marketing campaigns across planning, execution, experimentation, optimization, and performance analysis. The role offers the opportunity to build and scale paid subscription programs across new channels, creative strategies, and conversion opportunities. You will use rigorous measurement, incrementality testing, app economics, and customer insights to optimize investment against LTV and payback. Working closely with Product and Engineering, you will influence acquisition funnels, landing pages, product experiences, and marketing instrumentation. The environment is remote-first, highly autonomous, and mission-driven, with an emphasis on privacy-respecting growth and empowered project ownership. This role is ideal for an analytical growth marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and thrives in complex, fast-moving environments. Paid acquisition strategy: Lead the planning and execution of growth marketing initiatives designed to profitably increase paid subscribers across consumer subscription channels. Campaign ownership: Manage high-priority campaigns end to end, including strategy, channel selection, launch execution, optimization, testing, and post-campaign analysis. Channel expansion: Identify, launch, and evaluate new paid acquisition channels, including app store advertising, paid social, and mobile app networks, with a focus on incremental and sustainable growth. Subscription program development: Help build and scale a paid subscription marketing program from the ground up, establishing processes and strategies that can support continued subscriber growth. Creative and messaging experimentation: Develop and execute tests across creative concepts, messaging, and positioning, using results to improve acquisition efficiency and conversion. Conversion optimization: Partner with Product and Engineering to improve landing pages, acquisition funnels, product experiences, and instrumentation that influence paid subscriber conversion. Performance measurement: Analyze campaign and subscription economics using metrics such as LTV, payback, acquisition efficiency, and incremental lift to guide investment decisions. Experimentation and incrementality: Design and interpret experiments that measure true incremental impact, relying on aggregate measurement and rigorous analysis rather than user-level targeting and tracking. Strategic partnership: Work across teams to translate complex business and marketing challenges into actionable strategies and measurable outcomes. Program optimization: Continuously evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and reallocate resources toward initiatives that demonstrate profitable growth potential. Requirements Professional experience: 7+ years of experience in digital advertising or growth marketing, ideally including 2+ years focused on paid acquisition for freemium consumer subscription applications. Paid growth expertise: Demonstrated experience using digital marketing platforms such as app store advertising, paid social, and mobile app networks to scale subscriber growth profitably. Subscription marketing: Proven ability to build paid subscription acquisition programs from the ground up and optimize growth against LTV and payback rather than acquisition cost alone. Consumer product experience: Experience driving subscription growth within an established, high-traffic consumer product where subscription revenue represents a secondary revenue stream is preferred. Cross-functional collaboration: Track record of partnering with Product and Engineering teams to develop and optimize landing pages, funnels
